name: sgi-ti-uai
description: Sistema de Gestão de Melhorias Contínuas

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('index.source.html', 'index.html')" && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let html=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html', 'utf8'); html=html.replace(/(href|src)=\"\.\/assets\//g, '$1=\"./dist/assets/').replace(/(href|src)=\"\.\/js\//g, '$1=\"./dist/js/'); fs.writeFileSync('index.html', html);"
